notes.title: Railroad to the Next Update
notes.content:
G’day! everyone


[p align="start"]Have you been enjoying the last update, “Night Market”? It was the one where a mysterious night vendor appeared at midnight and offered a variety of unique decorative items. Oh… have you already enjoyed it to the fullest and now feel like you need something new? Perfect timing then — today we’re here to share a little about the next update that will be coming soon.
[p align="start"]In particular, this update will introduce a new type of vehicle and also bring changes to the farm animal system. Since this isn’t just about decorative items, it may even change the way you play the game~! In addition, we’re working on improvements to multiplayer stability and various quality-of-life features based on the feedback you’ve been sending us.
[p align="start"]So, shall we take a look at some of the new content first?
[p align="start"] 
New Contents
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/c1a3ee785f2ffc7599bc0adfe40c0de9342c9f86.jpg"]
[p align="start"]The first thing we’d like to show you is the new vehicle — the train. Dinkum already has many types of vehicles, but this train has a unique feature. To run, it needs proper tracks! (Just like in real life… haha.) Of course, you can place the train on areas without tracks, but it won’t be able to move!
[p align="start"]Even with that limitation, the train is the fastest ground vehicle added so far. If the conditions allow, you’ll be able to run from one end of your island to the other without much trouble. We hope you’ll enjoy designing your island in even more creative ways with the train and tracks.
[p align="start"] 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/5324f72c69769d3edbaaf9224977708fbead95e2.jpg"]
[p align="start"]A new farm animal is also being added. Its cute appearance, resembling a bandicoot, is quite charming! In addition, there will be some new animals with a somewhat familiar appearance. Details on how to obtain and use these new animals will be shared later in the patch notes when the update goes live. Beyond that, a new system related to farm animals is also on the way, so we ask for your interest and excitement!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/23fe1f301f66a28de19884fc9e1c56207c6b7336.jpg"]
[p align="start"] 
Multiplayer and QoL Improvements[p align="start"]Beyond new content, we are continuing to address long-standing issues that have persisted over time. Multiplayer inconveniences, in particular, have been among the most frequently reported and are a challenge we take very seriously. In this update, improvements to both performance and network quality will be made through a Unity engine update, and we’re looking forward to delivering a more stable and improved online play experience.
[p align="start"]Additionally, we’re incorporating other quality-of-life enhancements inspired by your feedback. These improvements are all about making gameplay smoother and ensuring you really notice the difference in your play environment.
[p align="start"] 
Future Updates and Development Direction[p align="start"]The update we’ve been talking about is targeted for release in October. Naturally, updates for Dinkum will continue beyond that. While nothing is finalized yet, discussions on new content and system improvements are ongoing. We’ve been exploring ideas like new terrain, maps, vehicles, tools, NPCs, and plenty of other fun things we believe you’ll enjoy.
[p align="start"]Rather than only showing finished results, we want to be more transparent by sharing the ideas and progress we’re working on. Moving forward, we aim to connect with you more often and more actively. For example, the character Mossy, who recently began streaming on Discord using screen sharing, is part of these efforts. Please see this as another way we’re making sure Dinkum continues to be something we build together with the community.
[p align="start"] 
[p align="start"]Since today’s post is just a small preview ahead of the official reveal of the next update, we weren’t able to share everything at once. We hope you’ll understand. Work on the update is moving forward each week, and once preparations are complete, we’ll share a more detailed preview in the form of patch notes.
[p align="start"]Your love and feedback are the driving force behind Dinkum’s growth. We’re always grateful for your support and will be back with you again soon. Until then, we hope you all enjoy your time!
[p align="start"] 


[p align="start"]See you in the game, Hooroo~!

notes.title: Notice of Known Issues After the “Night Market” Update(July 1 update)
notes.content:
G'day, everyone! 

Are you enjoying the “Night Market” update?

We’d like to share a summary of the currently known issues reported by players after the update. Please refer to the information below during your time in Dinkum.

If you experience any bugs or issues while playing Dinkum, please continue to report them via the \[Bug-report] channel. We’ll do our best to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.


 [Known Issues After the “Night Market” Update]
 

[strike]Villagers become stuck when hanging out[/strike](Fixed in the June 30 hotfix)

[strike]Sometimes villager will be standing in spot, unable to move when asking a villager to hang out, running far away so the villager respawns and then returning to their location. This will be fixed.[/strike]

[strike]Some lights not turning on at night[/strike](Fixed in the June 30 hotfix)

[strike]Floor lights and other lights may fail to turn on during nighttime. This is scheduled to be fixed.[/strike]

[strike]Animal feeder disappears after purchasing a Chook from Irwin’s Tent[/strike](Fixed in the June 30 hotfix)

Visual bug with earrings appearing red when worn

Aquamarine, emerald, and similar earrings may appear red at the point where they meet the character's ear. This will be fixed.

[strike]Voice chat prompt overlaps camera prompt in multiplayer[/strike](Fixed in the June 30 hotfix)

[strike]Adjustment to Berkonium spawn rate in Hot Hot Hot area[/strike](Fixed in the June 30 hotfix)

[strike]Based on feedback that Berkonium ore was too difficult to obtain, its spawn rate was increased. However, it was raised more than intended, so it has been adjusted to a slightly increased rate[/strike]



Confirmed (Expected Behavior or Already Explained)

Removal of refresh rate (Hz) setting option after update

The game’s frame rate now automatically adjusts to match your monitor’s refresh rate.

"Steam download data is corrupted" message preventing installation or launch

Temporarily resolved by uninstalling and reinstalling the Steam client.



Issues Under Investigation

Map markers for quests activating simultaneously

Partial cropping of certain loading screen images in specific conditions

Mustard coat appears black when worn or placed on the ground



We’ll continue to update this post as more information becomes available.


Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Night market update patchnote preview (Updated on 6/26)
notes.content:
※ June 26 Update – Additional Changes Added



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/f6666f3657baabc3a38b0ccf95fcf7ff29b4bbd2.jpg"]

G’day! mate!

 

We're bringing you a sneak peek at the upcoming update! Scheduled for June 26, this update brings a brand-new event, new content, Steam achievements, QoL improvements, and bug fixes — making your Dinkum life more enjoyable than ever.

After the preview of our official launch patch notes, we received many questions from you. From now on, we’ll continue to share patch notes 2–3 days before updates go live, so you can focus on gameplay on the day of!

Alright, let’s dive into the update details!

 
Update Schedule
June 26, 02:00 (UTC) / June 25, 19:00 (PDT)

No downtime required.

If you're already in-game, you can keep playing, but we recommend restarting after installing the update to access the new content.



 
New Features

Night Market Event
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/e8ad88fb6f051f99bab8ce4455bcdc75afc0a612.jpg"]

On the 19th of every season, a colorful tent will appear at the visitor's site. But it only opens its flaps after midnight, once your tiring day is over and the spooky late night sets in. Inside, you'll meet the Night Merchant, who claims to have come from the 'Depths'. (Once you've encountered them for the first time, their visit date will be marked on the calendar on the board.)

Inside the tent, you can buy items displayed by the Night Merchant or craft decorative accessories at the Jewellery Table. The highlight of this event is the 'Mystery bag' — filled with various event items, available for purchase with Dinks. You can also buy the 'Blistering bottle', which summons a heatwave the next day, and the 'Glowing box', which plays different visuals depending on the time.

Opening a mystery bag will grant you 3 random items from the list below.

Bone Mask

Bone Shirt

Bone Pants

Bone Shoes

Paper Hat

Glowing Mushroom Pot

Giant Bat Wings

Giant Feather Wings

Glowing Glider (Super Rare!)

Floor Candelabra

Die

Hand Bell

Glowing Path

Glowing PickAxe

Wind Chime

Glowing Dress

Glowing Coat

Glowing Sun Glasses

Jackaroo Wand (When using the wand, a whirlwind will form on the ground. Try jumping higher!)

 

There are glowing coats and dresses that shift colors, luminous tiles you can see even at midnight, and other unique items. Make your island stand out and enjoy!

 


Steam Achievements
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/9be0df075c331a1e0a5c61f17cc92bc3a62799a5.jpg"]

Steam achievements are finally here — a long-awaited feature! There are 25 quirky and creative achievements you can earn while playing. Among them are 8 entries selected from the recent community achievement contest. Time to show off your Dinkum prowess!

(Some achievements are not applied retroactively — you’ll need to meet the conditions again even if they were already fulfilled.)

 


New Items
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/3a9c3838bc44a4571bebd31623d67093eda9e253.jpg"]

Added 3 new furniture / decoration items.

Now you can place the wooden swing even in normal mode. Recipes are available through villager requests, Franklin’s shop, or blueprints.

Added 14 new clothing / cosmetic items.

You can obtain it through the recycling bin, the clothing store, or as gifts from villagers.

Added 7 new accessories which can be crafted at the Jewellery table in the Night Merchant’s shop.

 
Changes
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/9cde2a3469981efc6561310d512478de5b3125fe.jpg"]



Crafting stackable items now allows bulk crafting. Looks like we can go to bed a bit earlier. Hehe...

In winter, if a Wary Mu nest was destroyed, it may now respawn on each Saturday after sleeping.

Improved camera smoothness for character and vehicles

Improved camera when aiming

Improved aiming controls for controllers

Improved performance

Bone Bow now fires further and charges faster

Added Steam keyboard support when playing on Steamdeck or Big Picture Mode with a controller 

Improved legibility for UI text

Improved UI elements for smaller screens

(Updated on 6/26) Critters caught in Crab Pots are now counted in the pedia caught list 

(Updated on 6/26) Villager heart deterioration has been lowered

(Updated on 6/26) Villager path finding while following the character has been improved 

(Updated on 6/26) Whistling now makes a pet Diggo follow you, patting the Diggo will stop them following

(Updated on 6/26) A pet Diggo that is following you will have a glowing spot above their head

(Updated on 6/26) The refresh rate setting has been changed to automatically match the user's monitor refresh rate, and the option has been removed from the settings menu

 
Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug that caused “Must be Empty” message to appear when picking up empty seats and beds

Fixed a bug that prevented the player from taking multiple photos once time had hit late

Fixed a bug that allowed pergolas to intersect with each other, causing item loss when picked up

Fixed a bug that prevented festoons from connecting to fences correctly

Fixed a bug that prevented crops from being watered when it rained while in the mines or off the island

Fixed a bug that caused projectile weapons to fire backwards when exiting aiming

Fixed a bug that blocked certain positions in houses and guests houses from placing items on them, especially after upgrading the building

Fixed a bug that caused item placement on certain tiles to appear on a different tile

Fixed a bug that occasionally prevented the player from entering a certain shop located on a boat

Fixed a bug that caused NPCs to speak over each other dialogue bubbles

Made a change to prevent player’s dresses and skirts getting stuck in their waist

Fixed a bug that caused a weapon to drop with 1 durability remaining

Fixed a bug that caused furniture to “bounce” the first time when entering a house or guest house

Fixed a bug that caused the price in the catalogue to be shown incorrectly by 1 dink

Projectiles fired by players no longer do damage to other players and farm animals

 

If you have feedback or thoughts on this patch note or Dinkum in general, feel free to drop a comment on our Steam page or join the official Discord and share your voice!

 

See you in the game~ Hooroo!

notes.title: Official Launch Update Hot Fix
notes.content:
G’day! Hello, everyone!

We would like to share the details of the hotfix released on April 23, which addresses issues related to the official launch update.

While many players showed great excitement and support following the official launch update, we sincerely apologize to those who experienced difficulties due to various bugs and errors in the game.

Based on community feedback and internal review conducted after the update, we have prioritized and addressed several key issues in this hotfix. We will continue to listen to your feedback and strive to provide a better gameplay experience.

April 24, 2025 – 10:30 (UTC)
No downtime required.

Bug Fixes:
 Fixed a bug that made cocoons disappear when it was added to the inventory

notes.title: Dinkum Demo Version Release Announcement
notes.content:
*2025.04.23 Update – Multiplayer section edited


G'day, everyone!

To celebrate the official launch of Dinkum on April 23rd, we're also releasing a demo version! We're excited to release this demo so that even more future adventurers can discover what makes Dinkum so special. The demo offers a taste of the full Dinkum experience. If you have friends who are still on the fence about Dinkum, now's a great time to introduce them and get them in the game!

Scroll down for more details about the demo!


Dinkum Demo FAQ
Q: Is the content different between the demo and the full game?
A: The core gameplay is the same, but the demo includes the following limitations:
You can only play up to one in-game month. After that, you won't be able to load that save file again.
Only one save slot is available for the demo.
Creative Mode and developer commands are disabled in the demo.
Q: Can I play multiplayer in the demo?
A: Multiplayer is not available in the demo version.
Q: Can I keep playing the demo after one in-game month?
A: You'll need to delete your current save and start over. Purchasing the full game removes this restriction.
Q: If I buy the full game, can I continue from my demo save?
A: Yes! You can continue your progress by loading your demo save file in the full game. Just make sure to install the full game after purchase.
However, in the following cases, your saved data may not be retained.
If Steam Cloud is not enabled, or if your save file is stored only on your PC (local device) and you uninstall Dinkum from your Steam library, the save file will be deleted.
If there is no save file left on Steam Cloud or your PC (local device), you will not be able to continue your previous progress even after repurchasing Dinkum.
You can check whether Steam Cloud is enabled by following the path below:
Steam Library → Dinkum → Manage → Properties → General tab


If you want to chat about the game, come hang out on our Discord full of Dinkum discussions~


See you all in the game~! Hooroo!

notes.title: Creative Mode & Steam Achievements – Things to Know
notes.content:
G’day, everyone!

The official launch update is just around the corner! Not long ago, we introduced a preview of some of the upcoming changes included in the launch update. Among all the update contents, the one that garnered the most attention and inquiries from players has undoubtedly been Creative Mode.

Creative Mode is a system designed to help you decorate your island in a more creative and free-spirited way, saving time and effort, and sometimes simply satisfying your curiosity. However, because enabling Creative Mode would make it too easy to complete standard Steam achievements, we’ve implemented a system where any save file with Creative Mode enabled will not be eligible to earn Steam achievements.

To help prevent players from enabling Creative Mode without knowing about this limitation and then losing access to Steam achievements on their valuable save files, we’ve added a warning message that will pop up in-game when you select a mode (as shown in the screenshot below). Still, just in case someone misses the message, we’re also making this announcement to raise awareness—so please be extra cautious!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/3a146675b8ade2e0c4376b6217b92d7a0a753645.jpg


The Steam achievement system for Dinkum is currently in development. While we can’t give you an exact date yet, we’re working hard to make it available to everyone as soon as possible. For now, there are no achievements displayed, but once the system is implemented after the official launch update on the 23rd, any save file that has ever used Creative Mode will be excluded from achievement tracking—so please choose carefully.

To help prevent and resolve any potential issues, please refer to the following precautions and solutions:

 Play a different save file that does not have Creative Mode enabled to unlock achievements.
 Start a new game and play through it to unlock achievements.
 Back up your existing save files and replace them in case any issues occur.
Default save file location - C:\Users\[User name]\AppData\LocalLow\James Bendon


Lastly, regarding the Steam Achievement system we mentioned is currently under development — we’ll share more details in a separate announcement as soon as they are finalized.
We’re also planning to host a Steam Achievement Contest soon on the official Discord, where you can submit your fun and creative ideas!
We can’t wait to shape the future of Dinkum together with you. Your interest and participation mean the world to us!

 
If you want to chat about the game, come hang out on our Discord full of Dinkum discussions~


See you in the game~ Hooroo~!

notes.title: Official Launch Update Patch Notes Preview
notes.content:
*2025.04.22 Update – Removed note stating pergolas can be placed overlapping


G'day, everyone!

Here are the patch notes for the long-awaited official launch update! Packed with new things to play with, this update makes the world of Dinkum more vibrant and enriching. It's the perfect time to invite your mates over to your island and enjoy all the new fun together! You can even take them on a scenic ride in your two-seater plane to show off your beautiful island from above.

Along with all this new content, the update brings tons of improvements for a smoother and more stable gameplay experience. Multiplayer permissions have been refined to easily manage what your visitors can and can't do. Several quality-of-life upgrades have also been added to make your time in Dinkum even more pleasant.

Oh! To celebrate the official launch, James, our dear creator of Dinkum, has sent us a special message. Let's all give him a warm round of applause and take a look!

[hr] [/hr]

G’day everyone!

It’s been nearly 3 years since I released Dinkum into early access, and nearly 8 years since I started work on developing Dinkum.

In that time Dinkum has gone from a little project on my computer, to being played by thousands of people. Players who’ve truly made the game their own.

It’s been my finest pleasure to watch people play Dinkum, to see all the creations players have made on their island and to hear the stories and memories people have made inside that little game that used to live only on my computer.

So, for that I say thank you so much for playing Dinkum.

In the 3 years of early access I’ve been adding to Dinkum, offering updates with new items, features and adventures to experience. These updates have been shaped by the excitement and passion I have received from Dinkum players, as well as the hundreds of suggestions left by the Dinkum community.

So for that I wanted to say thank you to the community that helped Dinkum make it to 1.0.

After all the updates and new content added over the years, I believe Dinkum now feels complete. So that is why I’ve decided to leave early access and officially launch Dinkum. 

This doesn’t mean the end of Dinkum, and it certainly doesn’t mean the end of updates. All this means is: Dinkum is no longer in early access.

I hope you enjoy all the new features I’ve added in this update, a lot of these features are highly requested features. Some of them were hard to implement, but I believe they were worth the effort.

Thanks for taking your time to read this message. 

And as always, thanks for playing Dinkum.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/8e4b8b892bf1cf5af54ce25690a73871e3fc5dd4.jpg

[hr] [/hr]

As always, there's nothing better than jumping straight in and trying them out for yourself. But if you want to study the details, check out the full patch notes below.


Update Schedule:

 April 23, 2025 at 02:00 (UTC)
 No downtime maintenance required.
 If you are already in the game, you can continue playing. However, to access the update content, please exit the game, install the update, and then restart the game.



Patch Notes:
New Features

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/74126e7a2587a777eb9adbf3c585ff728c2d0b4e.jpg
- Creative mode has been added.
 In Creative mode, players can open their inventory and access the creative toolbar.
 Players can search and add items to their inventory.
Players can swap to the time / weather tab to adjust the in-game clock and weather.
Players can spawn Animals into their world.Once switched to Creative Mode, Steam achievements will be permanently disabled for that save file, so please choose carefully. (The Steam achievement system is currently in preparation. Further details will be provided at a later date.)
When selecting a save for single-player mode, players can press the cog icon to switch to default or Creative mode.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/22d097df540f41acbdfeaaf2d4d00b04b011abf3.jpg
- The Town Bell has been added.
The Town Bell Deed is unlocked after completing the Town Hall.
The Town Bell can be rung by interacting with it or hitting it with a weapon or tool
Once the bell has been rung, all players currently on the island can see an icon for each villager on their map (these icons last for 30 seconds).
Now, you don’t have to worry about Fletch getting lost and wandering off somewhere.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/2a3f8247327ac3f91dd94a503c84170549edf06d.jpg
- A Bug Terrarium has been added.
Terrariums will create cocoons when butterflies, moths, and spiders are placed into them.
Players can place the cocoons into a spinning wheel to produce silk.
The Bug Terrarium Recipe is unlocked when players reach level 30 in Bug Catching.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/d4c8b048a613e567455533e1b52ec1c0c3aa99f5.jpg
- New guest houses have been added.
The number of guest houses (extra homes) that can be built has increased from 3 to 4.
- Guest houses can now be rented out.
Players can buy a Rental Sign from John’s Goods and place it at the door of a guest house to rent it out.
Interacting with the sign once it’s placed will allow players to check the current rent, and the rent is automatically calculated by scoring the house’s interior decoration.
If the sign is placed there, one of the four new villagers will move in the next day.
The rent will be left on the small counter by the door of each guest house every Wednesday morning.
Players can take Guest Houses on and off the market whenever they wish.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/46b627dbd1b9007d170850ecc4dd862619571974.jpg
- Four new villagers have been added.
Players can meet new villagers after they move into a rented guest house.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/b5f2ff4e7a098fd4086b944e9a1f969099a5a5e7.jpg
- A new vehicle – Plane – has been added.
The plane can carry up to two players (A Pilot License is required to pilot the plane, but passengers can ride in the co-pilot seat without a license).
The plane flies faster than the helicopter but cannot hover in place.
The plane can land and float on water.
Franklyn can craft if he learns the recipe by giving him enough old discs and completing the berkonium mission (players who have met these requirements may need to offer Franklyn at least one shiny disc for him to discover the recipe).
- Gold Ore and Nuggets have been added.
When the island is experiencing a heat wave, there is a chance to dig up this very valuable treasure.
- Villagers now have Inventories.

 Villagers have their own inventory that can be accessed through a dialogue option while hanging out with them.
 Players can give villagers helpful tools to use while hanging out.
 While hanging out, they will use items from their own inventory to assist the player depending on the situation.
 When hanging out with a villager, they will rush over and revive the player if they’re nearby when the player is passed out. How reliable!

- Villagers can now wear clothing.

 Villagers may change into clothing in their inventory. So be sure to think about what they would like to wear the next time they ask for some new clothing.

- Villagers now have a new type of request.

 New dialogues have been added to decrease repetition for most villager requests.
 They may ask players to collect specific items depending on the season.

- Villagers now have random behaviors.

 Villagers now behave more naturally – eating random items from their inventory, fishing in the river, or catching bugs.
 When villagers have conversations with each other, they may occasionally show speech bubbles or emotes. If the player is nearby, they can read the dialogue.

- 3 new outfits have been added.
- 19 new furniture and decoration items have been added.
- 2 new bridges have been added.
- 15 new cassettes have been added.


Changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/ca115b59047781c792a380d97d7feed78b617b3a.jpg
- Island permission settings have been changed in multiplayer mode.
In multiplayer mode, the host of the game can access Island Permissions via the Settings tab.
The host can set their default permissions if it’s a visitor’s first time on the island.

notes.title: KRAFTON Q&A
notes.content:
To the dearest fans of Dinkum,

Since KRAFTON joined Dinkum's passionate journey, many of you have shared various thoughts and questions.
We truly appreciate your engagement, and we will try our utmost to listen to the voices of our community.

To help clarify some of the most frequently asked questions following the publisher change, we have compiled a list of explanations below.
We will continue to openly communicate with you and share updates whenever there is new information.

1. Is KRAFTON now developing Dinkum?

 No, Dinkum is still solely developed by James Bendon, while KRAFTON handles publishing activities.
 KRAFTON has partnered with James through a publishing agreement to introduce Dinkum to more players worldwide and make it available on multiple platforms so that new players can discover and enjoy the game.
 As part of this collaboration, KRAFTON now handles global operations, including marketing, promotional campaigns, localization, community management, and customer support. We will actively engage with players, gather feedback, and discuss potential improvements with James to enhance the game experience.
 Furthermore, KRAFTON provides legal support to protect the Dinkum IP and administers service and business operations, ensuring that James can focus entirely on development.


2. Will Dinkum's direction change due to this collaboration?           

 No, KRAFTON will not unilaterally change the direction of the game.
 We will listen to community feedback and work closely with James to support the development of even more attractive content.


3. There was an announcement regarding data administration. Does this mean my personal data is being accessed or used by KRAFTON?

 Since KRAFTON has assumed the publishing role for Dinkum, we have published a notification to make sure that players recognize this change.
 However, The way personal data is handled remains unchanged, and access to such data is strictly limited.
 Furthermore, All data is securely managed with encryption and other protective measures to ensure user safety.
 You can find more details in the official announcement.


4. Why do I need to agree to the EULA again to play Dinkum?

 Since KRAFTON has assumed the publishing role from James, the End User License Agreement (EULA) has to be reaccepted by players, following the publisher change on the Steam platform.
 This is a standard procedure that all game publishers must adhere to and an essential requirement that the platform provider must follow to administer the game service.
 The EULA update is an essential step to ensure stable service and protect player rights without impacting the ownership of the game or the individual's way of playing the game. Through these protection measures, players can safely enjoy Dinkum in the same environment as before without any disadvantages or restrictions.


5. Is Dinkum Together a completely separate game from the original Dinkum?

 Dinkum Together is a new title inspired by the original Dinkum, designed to offer a fresh and delightful experience on various platforms.                  
 Since the game is still in its early stages of development, there isn't much detailed information to be shared yet. However, we will make sure to post regular updates through the Dinkum Together Discord channel, so please stay tuned for more news.


We sincerely apologize for the insufficient communication provided regarding the publisher change, as our focus was directed toward the language support update. Moving forward, we will strive to improve our way of interacting with the dearest fans of Dinkum by delivering more precise information. Thank you to everyone who shared their valuable feedback.

Once again, thank you for your continued support.

Snow days will be somewhat rare, but they will occur more often if you have a way to to control the rain on your island…

This mine level is intended to be visited by late game players. You’ll want good gear, good food and maybe some good friends to help you explore the lava filled depths. There are large dungeon-like structures to loot for new treasure, and rare Berkonium nodes to find and return to the new Gem Crusher near the mine's entrance.

notes.title: The Breezy Autumn Update is Here!
notes.content:
G’day!

Can you sense the cooler breeze on your face and notice the trees changing colours? Do you find yourself reaching for a blanket at night or an extra jumper in the early morning? Are the temperatures outside rather comfy, with the sun no longer scorching you in seconds? If you’re feeling that cooler change, it can only mean one thing: Autumn has arrived in Dinkum. And this season’s Autumn has brought along the Breezy Autumn Update!

[previewyoutube=ZD0ggC_mr7Y;full][/previewyoutube]
When you stroll around your island, take a look around and see how more colourful this Autumn is. The trees have changed to shades of gold and orange, and if you’re paying attention during the night, you might see a new weather event. This rare event will happen more often during the Autumn and Winter seasons.

But don't just look up at the sky; take a moment to notice the Mushrooms sprouting from the ground. Different varieties of mushrooms will appear across the island during autumn mornings, but they will wilt at noon. You’ll want to gather these mushrooms nice and early, so you use them to cook up new food recipes or utilise them in crafting new items. Who knew these tiny fungi could be so versatile?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/88b2384f3281a8a9ddc6212a8b7c6ec5158d1789.png
As the nights grow chilly, there are always some ways to stay warm.

But it’s not just the weather! With this update, I’ve added some new items and quality-of-life changes that will make gameplay a lot more breezy! 

John now sells the handy Hand Trolley, capable of moving full containers! No need to empty containers before relocating them - convenience at its finest. In addition, building licence level 3 now gives access to the crafting recipe for the Advanced Crafting Tables. These fancy new tables can pull crafting resources from nearby chests, allowing players to craft up a storm. 

Oh, and Franklyn now offers a new contraption that will make sorting items from your inventory and into containers much easier. You might need to give him a shiny disc to make him learn it, but I’ll leave that as a surprise for you to discover!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/7066f997c2d03d51ff250e3ed9484ba9ef71c8ee.png

notes.title: Hotfix 0.8.1 - A message about save files
notes.content:
Hi there. I just wanted to let you know that I am aware that some players have been having issues with saving and loading their games.

Since releasing Dinkum I have paid as much care as possible to keeping player’s saves throughout the entire Early Access period. This always has been and continues to be very important to me.

For the Summer Sun Update we made a lot of changes to the internal of Dinkum, including writing a new save system. The old system was very bloated - it had far too many separate files and often caused problems with Steam Cloud syncs. The new system is much smaller, taking the file amount down from around 60 files to just 3.

The Summer Sun update was tested publicly for over three weeks, this was in part due to my concerns with the new save system. Over those 3 weeks, a lot of bugs were reported, but no issues were found relating to players using the new save system.

However, since the public release, some rare cases of save file corruption have been reported. For anyone that has experienced this I would like to sincerely apologize. I know how much some player’s islands mean to them and I can not express my regret enough.

I have been working tirelessly on improving the new save system and I’ve included these changes in this hotfix. I am hopeful that these changes will mitigate any further problems.

Once again, I apologize if your save was affected by these changes.

I hope this hotfix prevents these kinds of problems in future.

Thank you everyone for your understanding and patience,

James

Don’t worry though, as I have a lot more ideas for new content for you before the big final release. I’ll tell you all about it soon, but in the meantime, enjoy the new update. notes.content:
G’day everyone,
 
I hope you are all doing well this morning, afternoon, or evening, wherever you may be. I’ve been working on new Dinkum content for quite some time, and I am now happy to announce that the second major Dinkum update is ready for you to play! With the Bloomin’ Spring update a new resident is joining our community, some new wildflowers will spring up on the Island, you can build a new building in your town, dive deeper into the deep min, and many more surprises that I left here and there for you to find. If you want to know more details about what’s coming to Dinkum, keep on reading. But if you don’t want to spoil the fun of discovery, you can jump into your Dinkum island and find the surprises yourself. Whatever option you choose, I hope you enjoy all the new content. Ok, I’m just about to get into more details, so if you don’t want spoilers, now is the time to go!! But before you do, thank you for your support!

[previewyoutube=YwlNtbXORTQ;full][/previewyoutube]
You’re still here? In that case, let me tell you more about the Bloomin’ Spring update. From today you can say hello and become friends with Sheila, our new villager on Dinkum Island. You can find her at your local Visitor Site. Sheila loves food and her hobby is cooking. She is known to make some tasty tucker. If you want her to move permanently to your town, you’re going to have to cook up some treats for her. Sheila is the owner of Tuckerbox, a local tuckshop. And if you collect all the necessary materials to build it, she will happily run it for you and all the other residents so that everyone on the island can enjoy her treats.

James

notes.title: Dinkum Community Census Results
notes.content:
G’day everyone,

Over here in Australia, it’s starting to get warm and we’re slowly getting ready for summer. Hope you’re feeling warm and cozy too, wherever you are. I want to thank all of you who took the time and participated in the last Dinkum Community Census. I have to admit that I didn’t expect so many of you to take part in it - there were nearly 10 thousand people who filled out the survey! And a big thank you to those of you who left some words of support and love in the Census. Reading them filled my creative juices to the max! 

So let’s quickly summarise the results of Dinkum’s Community Census.

First up, I’ve asked you how you like Dinkum in its current stage on a scale of 1 - 10.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/c04bd540fe2bb9174b224c56181df2c7bfee184f.png

Most of you rated Dinkum in the 7 to 10 range, with 8 being the most frequently chosen value. That means you are quite happy with the game’s current stage, which makes me really happy to see! Of course, this doesn’t mean that the development ends here - oh no! This is just the beginning. 

Next question - which mode you play the most.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/9f39098c87a3b2f88c96e4d96f625b0f26421d1f.png

It looks like more than half of you play Dinkum in a single-player mode, and a quarter of you play a bit of both. That really took me by surprise. This doesn't mean anything will change going forward with multiplayer support. After all, more than 45% of you are playing Dinkum with friends at some point. Your thoughts and suggestions are being listened to. 

Now let’s see what you like the most about Dinkum.

From all your answers I could pick a few of the most common responses, which were:

- The Australiana theme.
- Building the town, ability to decorate, and being able to express yourself through designing and building.
- Farm Animals and wildlife.
- That the game is relaxing (chill and cozy).
- That you can play with family/friends.
- Exploration - finding little interesting things, stories, items, and how they work with each other.
- Ability to customise the character.

Next is what you like the Least about Dinkum.

Same as above I could pick a few most common replies here as well:

- Mines need more variety / are too scary and too difficult / pass is too expensive.
- Tools durability / breaking too fast.
- Terraforming is a bit fiddly. 
- Cooking - too few recipes and not balanced.
- Too few decoration items and non-livable structures for the town, ie gazebos. 

And finally, what would you like to see more of in Dinkum.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/3ee4045b1f39798674435a71ebfe71a75cdf99ba.png

This was an interesting question for me too and I was surprised how high on the list was the Wildlife. I see a lot of you like Vombats and the Roos! Besides those answers, you also mentioned a couple of other things. There are too many to include here but thank you for all of them. 

Now, what does this all mean? Well, thanks to your answers I have a better feel of what you like and dislike about Dinkum. The good thing is that a lot of the ideas that you had and the things that annoyed you the most are the things that I wanted to focus and work on too. It was good to know that we all feel a little bit similar in which direction Dinkum should head. All of your info was super valuable and if I make any major changes to the roadmap, I will let you know! 

Thank you once again for filling out the Census and thanks for playing Dinkum. I’ll see you all on the island!


Speak to you soon,

James

notes.title: House Warming update is here!
notes.content:
G’day everyone,

Today is the day that you can enjoy brand-new Dinkum content as the House Warming update is here! While the update is downloading, let me tell you a little bit more about it.

One of the first updates you will come across is a new wild animal - The Frilly. They are inspired by one of my favourite native Australian creatures. You will find Frillies roaming around in the desert biome. But be careful around them! These fellas are fast and if provoked, they will fight back! They have a very quick bite and another surprise if you make them angry enough. If you do manage to kill one you may receive a thunder sack with which you can use to craft a new item - which might be quite useful while exploring the underground.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/078699a8d6d4c20bb25b9d1afe1c5f82485b5b23.png
Looks like this Frill really wants to catch us!

Next up on the new content list are the new Guest Houses. From now on you will be able to add up to three of them on your island. You can use them as a place to store all your crops and farming materials in one place, or maybe you need a house for all your hats? Better yet, they can be a place for your friends to stay when they come and visit your island. So build a few and make your friends feel at home. The deeds for these will be offered by Fletch once you’ve upgraded your tent into a house. I am sure you will find a great use for them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/a93dc7ec25a39ec4d10ee90707fc8d5266f17686.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/43665f1c429b8b310db7cd67240908cbb8a4430b.png
New customisable Guest Houses are here for you - and your guests of course!

In addition, everyone’s favourite barber, Sally, can now be a permanent resident of the island, opening up a new hair salon in your town. Getting that new look just got a lot more convenient.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/aa43d02f99cb36ba2339d8d1e50092ecb67c13f6.png
Sally can now move to the Island! Looks like the town is about to get more stylish.

I have seen a lot of suggestions involving storage and item management and I agree with everyone! Some highly suggested features (auto sort, auto stack) are still in the works. But, another common suggestion was to allow you to customise your crates and chests. So now you can colour crates and chests using paint to help you keep track of what crate has what.

And finally, key binding! This has been highly requested, so here you go, bind away! Thanks to your comments and suggestions, I’ve also added the ability to key-bind up to two different keys per action. However, rebinding for gamepads is something that needs a bit more time, sorry! I want to make Dinkum as accessible as it can be for all players, so I will continue to make these kinds of changes.

There are a bunch of other new items, recipes and secrets to track down in this update as well. I wanted the first update to be a bit bigger than what was on the road map, so I hope you all enjoy it. Also, a big thank you to everyone in the Dinkum community and Discord for all your help and support so far. I’m so grateful to have a bunch of creative, funny and kind people playing my little game.  I love seeing what you’ve built, reading your posts and watching you all play.

I hope you enjoy the update!

James
